Title: Generally available: Azure OpenAI Service in UK South

Body.Content:
Azure OpenAI Service is now available in the UK South region. UK South supports gpt-35-turbo at launch.

With this regional expansion, we are proud to bring the world’s most advanced AI models—including GPT-3.5 and ChatGPT to Azure customers in another region within Europe, backed by Azure AI-optimized infrastructure, enterprise-readiness, compliance, data security, and privacy controls, along with many integrations with other Azure services.

To learn more about models and regional availability for Azure OpenAI Service, see https://aka.ms/oai/models
